Market today: Mixed signals for your tech/chip heavy book. AI stocks might be bottoming, but a major AI fund collapse highlights extreme volatility. Fed rate hike fears also linger, creating uncertainty for growth names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-53.46%) and SPAL (-61.21%) are leveraged, deep in the red, and flagged for attention. Their default stops are ineffective. QQQI (-5.95%), QQQ (-3.68%), and SMH (-14.52%) are also flagged, with stops near current prices. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Monitor for clearer signs of an AI sector bottom and any firming of Fed rate hike expectations. Also, keep an eye on the S&P 500's key battleground level.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, losing positions.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red. Adjust stops to realistic levels or consider cutting losses.
Monitor QQQI, QQQ, SMH: These flagged positions are near their stops. Be ready to trim if breached.
